rules.if: {industry} in ('Money Services & FinTech', 'Precious Metals & Jewelry', 'Logistics & Import/Export')

_notes: accounts.closed_date: never earlier than owner_person_id.customer_since, owner_business_id.incorporation_date, opened_date.
joint_holder_of.since: never earlier than person_id.customer_since, account_id.opened_date, opened_date, owner_person_id.customer_since, owner_business_id.incorporation_date.
director_of.since: never earlier than person_id.customer_since, business_id.incorporation_date.
referred.referred_at: never earlier than referrer_person_id.customer_since, referred_person_id.customer_since.
signed_in.signed_in_at: never earlier than account_id.opened_date, device_id.first_seen_date, first_seen_date, person_id.customer_since.
